name: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company provides inorganic chemical products, including chromium compounds, phosphorus compounds, silicates and silica products, and other inorganic chemicals, such as lithium chloride solution N, sodium sulfate, sodium bisulfate, potassium permanganate, and cuprous oxides.
